hero.headline: Concerts, graduations, events and portraits.
hero.intro: I'm Rick Mongia, a photographer and videographer working across New Jersey, New York City and the Seattle area. I make images that hold up printed large and look right on your feed.

about.heading: Behind the camera
paragraphs: I'm a student at Rutgers University, splitting my time between New Jersey and Washington State. I started taking photos in middle school and launched Mongia Media to give people affordable, high-quality photo and video they can count on.
I specialize in portrait, real estate, event and street photography, plus videography, and I'm always open to travel for the right project.
Off the clock I'm playing guitar and bass, exploring new places, or spending time with family and friends.
about.areas: New Jersey, New York City, Seattle and the PNW. Available to travel.

faq.q: Where are you based, and where do you shoot?
faq.a: I'm based in New Brunswick, NJ and shoot across New Jersey and New York City. I'm also in the Seattle area and the Pacific Northwest regularly, and I'm open to travel for the right project.

faq.q: Do you offer both photography and videography?
faq.a: Yes. I shoot photo, video or both, including short-form video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.
Yes. I'm a Rutgers student myself and shoot graduation photos, senior portraits and ceremonies around New Brunswick, across New Jersey and in NYC.

faq.q: What kinds of shoots do you take on?
faq.a: Events, concerts, portraits and headshots, graduations, real estate, weddings and engagements, social media content, product and commercial work, and family sessions.

faq.q: How do I book a shoot?
faq.a: Pick a time for a free 30-minute planning call. We'll go over the vision, locations and timing, and I'll send a quote after.
